app.name: Domain Availability
app.subtitle: Check domain availability
app.description: Check whether an exact domain name is available to register, check several at once, and suggest available names for a brand or idea. Uses live public registration data; never guesses.
capabilities: Check one exact domain for availability
Check up to 20 domains in one request
starter_prompts: Suggest a domain for my plumbing business
app.release_notes: Initial submission. Read-only RDAP availability checks, no auth, no UI.

tools.name: check_exact_domain
tools.description: Check whether an exact domain name is available to register. Use when the user asks if a specific domain is taken, free, or available.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.description: Exact fully-qualified domain to check, e.g. example.com.

annotation_justifications.readOnlyHint: True because the tool only reads public registration status and changes nothing locally or remotely.
annotation_justifications.openWorldHint: True because the tool queries live public RDAP registration infrastructure on the open internet.
annotation_justifications.destructiveHint: False because an availability lookup cannot delete, overwrite, charge, or irreversibly change anything.

tools.name: batch_check_domains
tools.description: Check availability for up to 20 exact domain names at once. Use when the user lists several domains to compare.

inputs.name: domains
inputs.description: Between 1 and 20 exact fully-qualified domain names.

annotation_justifications.readOnlyHint: True because batch lookup only reads public registration status for each name.
annotation_justifications.openWorldHint: True because each lookup queries live public RDAP infrastructure on the open internet.
annotation_justifications.destructiveHint: False because availability lookups have no side effects individually or in batch.

tools.name: find_available_domains
tools.description: Suggest available domain names for a business, brand or idea. Use when the user wants domain ideas rather than checking one exact name.

inputs.name: keywords
inputs.description: Brand, business or idea keywords to base suggestions on.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.description: How many options to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

annotation_justifications.readOnlyHint: True because suggestion generation and availability filtering only read public data.
annotation_justifications.openWorldHint: True because candidate availability is verified against live public RDAP infrastructure.
annotation_justifications.destructiveHint: False because suggesting names changes nothing anywhere.

positive.prompt: Check pog.pet and pog.town for me.
I like Pogtown. Give me ten strong available .com alternatives.
Which of these is free: alpha.io, alpha.co, alpha.dev?

negative.prompt: Why is .com usually preferred for startups?
Brainstorm funny names for a dog show.

third_party_integrations.name: RDAP public registration data (IETF open protocol, no key, no ToS)
